question:
Which figure from the given options would replace the question mark (?) if the following figure series were to be continued?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d0c8a8eb1f8f065dbc7182fe33eb201e761b326380a3122baaf2fc9882676d12.png]
solution: The logic followed here is: **In figure 1 to 2 and figure 3 to 4:** Bottom-middle and bottom-right symbols are interchanging their position and bottom-left symbol is the same. All middle symbols and all top-symbols are interchanging their position with each other in clockwise.
